PHB.checkDC: End-of-target-turn Constitution saving throw to end the spell
notes: On a spell-attack hit, halve the target’s damage from Strength-based weapon attacks while the spell lasts. This spell deals no HP damage. Resolve the affected target and Concentration at the table.

Successful Constitution save: Disadvantage on the target’s next attack roll before your next turn starts. Failed save: Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtract 1d8 from all of the target’s damage rolls; repeat the save at each turn’s end to end the spell. The 1d8 reduces damage and never deals HP damage. Resolve the target and Concentration at the table.
Damage event: a creature starts its turn inside the 60-ft-radius darkness. Wisdom save: half damage on success. Resolve magical darkness, Concentration and affected creatures at the table.

Damage event: a creature starts its turn in the 30-ft-radius water. Failed Strength save: damage and pull 10 ft toward the center; success: no damage or pull. Place only on ground or water; track difficult terrain, positions and Concentration at the table.

EGW.checkDC: Strength check to pick up or move an unattended object in the sphere before your next turn starts
notes: On casting: creatures in a 10-ft-radius sphere make a Constitution save; success halves damage. Only a failed save halves Speed until the end of that target’s next turn. Resolve target Speed and object movement at the table.

Constitution save: half damage on success. Only a failed save causes rapid aging, halved walking Speed and Disadvantage on attacks, ability checks and saves; the target has 30 days before death by old age. Wish or 9th-level Greater Restoration can reverse the aging effects. Resolve target state at the table.

XGE.checkDC: Escape Strength check using the restrained target’s Action

notes: Initial grasp or Action to reach for a new target: Strength save; failure deals damage and restrains, success deals no damage. Place the Medium hand in a visible unoccupied 5-ft ground space within casting range. Moving it or choosing another target releases the previous target.
Action while the hand already restrains this target: Strength save; success halves the crushing damage. Resolve the target, restraint and Concentration at the table.
Initial 20-ft-radius explosion: Dexterity save; success halves this damage and prevents the later damage. A failed save schedules the separate acid damage at the end of that target’s next turn.

notes: Only after failing the initial save: automatic damage at the end of that target’s next turn, with no additional save. These dice never increase with slot level. Resolve each recipient separately.
Initial Wisdom save for one target: failure causes Frightened while the spell lasts. This initial event deals no damage. Resolve fear, target eligibility and Concentration at the table.

Only a target still Frightened by this spell makes this Wisdom save at the end of its turn. Failure deals the displayed damage; success deals no damage and ends the spell for that target. This is separate from the initial fear save.

Initial Wisdom save for creatures in a 30-ft-radius sphere: failure causes Frightened while the spell lasts. This initial event deals no damage. Resolve fear, target eligibility and Concentration at the table.

Only a target still Frightened by this spell makes this Wisdom save at the end of its turn. Failure deals the displayed damage; success deals no damage and ends the spell for that target. This is separate from the initial fear save.

At each of your turn ends, roll 1d6: 4–6 shifts you to the Ethereal Plane. Return at your next turn’s start or spell end to an eligible space within 10 ft of departure. Track position and planar interactions at the table.

Failed Wisdom save: no Bonus Actions or Reactions; roll 1d10 each turn start for behavior. The die selects behavior, not HP damage. Repeat the save each turn end to end the effect on that target. Upcasting adds 5 ft of radius per slot above 4; resolve behavior and targets at the table.
Outdoors only; adjust weather stages within 5 miles. Each change takes 1d4 × 10 minutes; the die measures time, not HP damage. The spell ends if you go indoors. Weather effects remain with the DM.

A willing touched target ignores difficult terrain and magical Speed reduction, Paralysis and Restraint; its Swim Speed equals its Speed. Spending 5 ft of movement escapes nonmagical restraints. Higher slots add one target per level above 4. Resolve movement at the table.

Choose one skill for a willing touched creature. While the spell lasts, add 1d4 to ability checks using that skill. This is not an attack/save bonus or HP damage; track Concentration and the chosen skill at the table.

After one hour eating, up to 12 participants gain Poison resistance and immunity to Frightened and Poisoned for 24 hours. Increase each participant’s HP maximum by 2d10 and grant the same HP amount. Track the maximum increase and its expiry separately.

For an eligible Humanoid dead no more than 10 days, use the 1d10 result or the DM’s choice for a new species. Resolve return, new species choices and replacement of old species traits at the table; this die is not HP damage.
